chapters.label: Berlin, 2015
chapters.text: Berlin, 2015, the Champions League final. Barcelona against Juventus, just four minutes in. Jordi Alba races down the left. Neymar, then Andrés Iniesta... Ivan Rakitić sidefoots it in!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again. Neymar flicks it inside. Iniesta dances into the box and slides it across.

chapters.label: Right on time
chapters.text: Rakitić arrives on the penalty spot at just the right moment. A calm sidefoot, and it is in! Barcelona lead, one–nil.

chapters.label: Arrive and finish
chapters.text: Arrive in the box at the right moment. Then finish fast, before a defender can block your shot.
